title: Integer multiplication below `n n`

result.label: Integer multiplication below `n n`
result.statement: Multiplies two n -bit integers exactly at every input length in deterministic worst-case time O(n( n)^ 1- ), with =2^ -182 , on one fixed finite-alphabet Turing machine with finitely many one-dimensional tapes. This disproves the Schönhage–Strassen n n optimality conjecture in the ordinary multitape bit model.
